'''Stel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3636 BBY]] a crisis struck when former [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] transferred his consciousness to Ziost and possessed a number of Imperial soldiers, using their bodies as a puppets to spread murder and chaos. A [[Form 98BG-HM7]] was filed and Stel made a public service announcement, urging civilians to maintain order during the evacuation.
